question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Confess
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disavow**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Confess"** means to admit or acknowledge something, often a wrongdoing or a secret. (स्वीकार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She confessed to stealing the money from the drawer.
 
 
 
• **"Disavow"** means to deny responsibility or association with something, or to refuse to acknowledge something. (अस्वीकार करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He disavowed any connection to the controversial project.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'Confess'** is **'Disavow'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Disavow**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scare** (डराना): To cause fear or frighten someone.

 
 
• **Example:** The loud noise scared the children.
 
 
 
• **Witness** (गवाह): Someone who sees an event, typically a crime or accident, occur.
 
 
• **Example:** The witness testified in court about what he saw.
 
 
 
• **Preface** (भूमिका): An introduction to a book, often written by the author.
 
 
• **Example:** The author wrote a brief preface explaining the purpose of the book.

योग्य उत्तर आहे: **Disavow**.
